system:
Extract metadata from a PR/commit message and respond ONLY with a JSON object with these fields:
- "type": one of ["feat","fix","refactor","docs","chore","test"]
- "scope": the affected area of the system, decided in this order:
  1. if the title has an explicit scope, as in "fix(parser): ...", use it;
  2. otherwise infer it from the title or body ONLY if the text names a concrete
     part of the system (e.g. "the billing service" -> "billing", "the CLI parser" -> "cli");
  3. otherwise null. A scope that only repeats the type (e.g. "docs" for a docs
     change) or names no concrete area is null.
- "breaking_change": true or false
- "issues": list of issue keys (e.g. ["PROJ-123"]), or [] if none
